expectation: Cytoplasmic panCK filling epithelial cells: here the columnar epithelium lining the crypts and villi should be bright, while stroma and lumen stay dark. It should overlap the E-cadherin-positive epithelium in row E.
observed: A: diffuse yellow haze over slide and tissue, bands off-tissue, speckle. B/C: epithelial layer blue/unstained; yellow is lumen debris, blobs, stromal haze. D: off-tissue blobs. E: Ecad clear honeycomb; panCK haze+specks not on it.
why: The epithelium that E-cadherin clearly marks is not panCK-positive; the signal is haze, debris and off-tissue blobs rather than an epithelial population.
notes: E-cadherin outlines the epithelium crisply, but panCK leaves those cells dark. Its signal is background haze, bright debris in the lumen and stroma, and glow outside the tissue, so the stain looks failed.
